errors.evidence: The pie chart clearly contains five sectors (blue, red, orange, green, and purple), not four.

errors.text_span: Третият е червен сектор с 14,3%, отговарящ на категорията „5-10%“.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly orders the sectors by size. The third largest sector is the green one at 19%, not the red one at 14.3%.
The green sector, at 19%, is not the smallest. The smallest sector is the purple one, at 9.5%.
The legend contains five colored markers corresponding to the five categories shown in the pie chart, not four.
